bnpb_bpbd_kabkot_check.limitation: Contains only regency/city BPBD administrative centroid status and office contact metadata; contains zero fire-station coordinates, zero fleet counts, zero crew counts, and zero budgets.

synthetic_scenario_separation.scenario_note: Synthetic planning scenario anchored to verified Riau 0.1 deg priority grid; real BPBD/Manggala Agni inventory not available locally.
synthetic_scenario_separation.strict_separation_policy: Synthetic operational parameters in config/optimization.yaml are never written into empirical feature parquets and remain strictly labeled is_synthetic_scenario=True.

missing_agency_fields.missing_fields: facility_id, agency (BPBD/Manggala Agni/TNI-Polri/MPA), daops_or_posko_name, exact_lat, exact_lon, operational_status (permanent vs seasonal posko)
missing_agency_fields.required_agency: BPBD Provinsi Riau & KLHK/Kemenhut Balai PPIKHL Sumatera (Manggala Agni)
missing_agency_fields.impact_on_optimization: Module 1 (Base Location) currently evaluates 40 grid-derived synthetic candidate sites instead of actual Daops/Posko locations.
Module 2 (Base Capacity) uses synthetic small/medium/large tier definitions from config/optimization.yaml.

missing_agency_fields.missing_fields: fire_trucks_count, slip_on_units, water_tankers_count, portable_high_pressure_pumps, hose_length_m, vehicle_serviceability_status
missing_agency_fields.required_agency: BPBD Riau, Dinas Damkar Kab/Kota Riau, & Manggala Agni
missing_agency_fields.impact_on_optimization: Module 3 (Fleet & Equipment) relies on synthetic fleet totals (24 trucks, 18 tankers, 60 pumps).

missing_agency_fields.missing_fields: active_personnel_count, manggala_agni_brigades_regu, bpbd_trc_count, mpa_volunteers_count, shift_schedule, pump_specialist_certifications
missing_agency_fields.impact_on_optimization: Module 4 (Personnel Scheduling) relies on synthetic total_personnel_available=320 and uniform shift assumptions.

missing_agency_fields.required_agency: BNPB Pusdalops, BPBD Riau, & Komdigi/Diskominfo Riau
missing_agency_fields.impact_on_optimization: Module 5 (Comms Coordination) uses a 55 km Euclidean spatial proxy instead of RF propagation or existing repeater sites.
Module 6 (Budget Optimization) sweeps synthetic budget scenarios (15,000-65,000M IDR).
